programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.
